name: Airvice — bold condensed AC repair

source.template: Airvice – AC Repair Services HTML5 template (index.html)
source.method: Computed styles measured in Chromium at 1440px (scripts/extract-template.mjs → measured.json); reference-1..6.jpg are the full page in order. Grey 'PHOTO' tiles are photo slots — their size and position are the design; fill them with the lead's real photos.

character: Loud, energetic, conversion-driven AC/repair site. A semi-condensed display face (Saira Semi Condensed) at very large sizes (60–80px, hero in UPPERCASE), a hot orange accent against deep navy, pill buttons, a split header with a coloured phone block, and 120px section rhythm. Looks like a busy, confident service company with a phone that rings.
reuse: Use for AC repair / HVAC / air conditioning / appliance repair / plumbing / electrical / emergency-service leads that want a bold, high-energy, phone-first look. Put the lead's brand colour in the orange 'accent' slot (or in the navy 'primary' slot if the brand is dark) and keep the other as a deep neutral.

primary.note: One condensed family for everything. Display sizes are HUGE (hero 80px uppercase, h2 60px) with tight 1.08–1.12 line-height — that is the look. Body 16px/500.

scale.note: a small brand-mark icon before it, 20px gap to the h2
giant pale '25' behind the experience block

color.notes: Orange + navy/blue high-contrast pairing. The lead's brand colour takes the accent slot; ink/dark stay near-black navy. Big solid colour blocks (orange tile, navy tile, orange form box, navy team band) carry the energy.

spacing.container: 1280px max content column with 32px side padding (20px under 768px) — the SAME column for top bar, header, every section and footer. (Template measured 1200px; standardised to 1280 so every mockup shares one grid.)
spacing.sectionPaddingY: 120px top / 90px bottom (cards carry 30px bottom margin, so visual rhythm ≈120)
spacing.headingStack: eyebrow 20px → 20px → 60px h2; heading row often has the h2 LEFT and a pill button RIGHT on the same line
spacing.hero: 900px photo, content LEFT-aligned in the container; below it two big 685px-wide CTA tiles overlap the hero's bottom edge by ~80px

components.topBar: 60px, #f3f6f9: a slanted accent block on the far left with a short promise ('No hidden charges' — only if true in FACTS), then hours · address · email separated by 1px vertical dividers.
components.header: 100px white: logo, UPPERCASE nav, and on the right a coloured block (primary blue, bleeding to the viewport edge) holding a round accent phone icon, the phone number at 24px/600 white and a white pill 'Get Quote' button.
components.button: Pill (50px radius), 60px tall, 0 45px padding, 16px/600. Accent orange default, blue for the hero, outline pill for filters.
components.ctaTiles: Two side-by-side tiles (orange | navy) 166px tall overlapping the hero, each with a 60px line icon, 36px/600 white title and a circled arrow.
components.aboutMasonry: Left: tall 285×600 photo + stacked 285×180 photo and a navy stat tile ('200+ Project Done' 72px/600 white). Right: eyebrow, 60px h2, paragraph, a pale quote box (#f3f6f9, 30px padding, 26px/600 quote with a big quote glyph), then a pill button + round founder avatar with name/role.
components.factsRow: 4 columns: outline icon with a quarter-circle accent arc behind it, then a 65px number beside a two-line label.
components.serviceGrid: 2×2 white tiles (270×257, padding 45, border) with an 80px pale icon square, small category label and 24px title; the active tile is solid accent with a small arrow notch at the bottom. Beside it a 570px photo with a white text card overlapping its bottom-left.
components.estimateForm: Accent-coloured box (padding 50) with 36px 'Free Estimate' title and 60px-tall white inputs (name, phone, service select, message), full-width dark submit button. Sits over a photo, with a giant pale '25' watermark and '25+ Year Working Experience' block beside it — use only the lead's real years from FACTS.
components.team: #1d284b band, centred heading, 4 square 270px photos each with a navy caption bar (role 14px, name 27px/600).
components.portfolio: Heading left + outline pill filter chips right; 3 × 370×410 project photos.
components.footer: Dark navy, 115px top padding, 4 columns (about, links, services, emergency phone at 24px/600 with an accent label).

blueprint.spec: 60px bar + 100px header with the coloured phone block
900px photo, left-aligned: small play/video chip → 80px UPPERCASE 2-line headline → 30px subline → blue pill button
orange + navy tiles overlapping the hero bottom (use the lead's two main service types)
padding-top 120, masonry photos left, text + quote box right
padding 80/70, 4 stats (only real numbers from FACTS; drop the row if there are none)
pale patterned band, heading left + 'More Service' pill right, 2×2 tiles + photo with overlapping text card
photo + experience watermark left, orange form box right
navy band, 4 photo cards (only if the lead has team photos)
photo half + navy half with quote, name 27px, stars

signatureMoves: Condensed display type at 60–80px, hero in UPPERCASE
Coloured phone block bleeding off the right of the header
Two big colour tiles overlapping the bottom of the hero
Solid accent 'active' service tile with an arrow notch
Giant pale watermark numeral behind the experience block
